# data.docker_secret

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Looks up one swarm secret's metadata (`GET /secrets/{id}`) by `id` or `name`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. The Engine never returns secret data, so `inspect` holds the ID, version, times, name, labels and driver only.
